title: Melukara and Kottathoor Kaithakkodi win Aranmula Uthrittathi Boat Race
description: Melukara Palliyodam tops in A-Batch final, followed by Koipram Palliyodam and Edasserimala East Palliyodam in second and third positions respectively. Kottathoor -Kaithakkodi Palliyodam first in B-Batch category
